fields.statement: At e62f6b443, read the diff (internal/api/session_done.go: isLeafVerifier + verifierRecordMissing, a Conflict with next `rhiza run findings --leaf <leaf>` whose message names both `rhiza run findings` and the Evidence recipe; new internal/api/session_done_verifier_test.go). The other SessionDone tests pass too, as do `-run 'Leaves|Verifier|Evidence'`; go vet and gofmt are clean. Scripts that run verifier sessions pass (bugfix-workflow-autonomous, run-ship-ci-fix, run-ship-ci-lint-fix, run-ship-conflict-fix, run-ship-model-conflict). plan-workflow-pr fails on the plan-reviewer prompt text at line 77. That comes from sibling leaf done-own-command-guide (c44cd76a7 changed plan.toml prompts), not from this leaf's diff.
